exposure: arrival as an emergency condition by ambulance
cohort: Women with potentially life-threatening conditions (PLTCs) due to severe pregnancy-related complications
finding: Hepatic dysfunction, multiple/unspecified disorders, arrival as an emergency condition by ambulance, and history of previous cesarean section were significantly associated with maternal death compared to maternal near-miss.
mod_finding: History of previous cesarean section was significantly associated with maternal death compared to maternal near-miss.
